features.scope: Actual Latin and Fandol CJK glyph geometry, including opening a Chinese caret position and committing synthetic composition once with unchanged surrounding LaTeX bytes.

Plain headings and escaped literals, paragraphs with nested marks, and source mapping for proof, abstract, quote, and nested lists. The Windows and macOS jobs cover abstract and quote paragraph splitting and joining, explicitly selected bold on new text, justified paragraphs and the required preamble update, and marked prose beside inline math. LuaLaTeX reports a native glyph for the escaped caret. More text environments and structural operations in nested containers remain pending.

The browser gates cover empty and nonempty cells, mixed marked text and math in tabularx, ordinary tabular, tabularx and tabularray axis edits, and ordinary tabular and tabularray vertical merge and split with exact source writeback and undo. Windows and macOS real-engine jobs check glyph ownership and unchanged visible geometry for both kinds of row span. The tabularx row span has direct source and parser tests. Advanced row-and-column spans and arbitrary cell styles remain pending.

Included prose and display math edit their owning source file. Cross-file copy and replacement can include complete formulas and endpoints inside single-paragraph center and proof environments, with atomic undo and redo. The native exit shortcut and file outline navigate the composed source. Detached fragments inherit the preamble. Folding retains page numbering and partial edge placeholders and handles an include sharing a line. Live and observation sessions retain a staged child after an edit. Selections across more complex environments and repeated source ownership need additional coverage.

A staged raster can be edited from native Canvas and a registered PDF. Repeated PNG occurrences resolve to separate source ranges using the real graphicx transformation, confirmed on Windows and macOS. Direct clicks open standalone or floating TikZ and the selected nested subfigure from a registered real LuaLaTeX PDF. The native workspace can select an exact opaque block in Source. Other nested float content still needs direct editing coverage.

A registered PDF with matching page dimensions and ownership supports semantic editing. Native geometry from a real two-platform LuaLaTeX run provides browser evidence for opening standalone TikZ for editing and updating a nearby formula. Mismatched dimensions disable editing. More complex page objects remain pending.

The native command palette covers verified math structures and the status bar displays the active nested field. Formula label changes preserve the selected equation or alignment row and its surroundings. Keyboard commands insert inline and numbered display formulas, accept an initial display formula in a blank document, and leave a nested fraction with Ctrl+J. The prose palette inserts an exact page break, edits document metadata, and offers project input and include commands.

Copy, cut, formatted paste, whole inline formula selection, synthetic Chinese composition, and queued input during a forced geometry delay. Verified selections within one paragraph copy formatting alongside plain text, and native math accepts validated LaTeX fragments from the clipboard. Browser checks cover vertical caret and page navigation, the textarea anchor during scrolling, and the first preedit after exiting inline math. Physical input methods and broader cross-file editing remain pending.

The opt-in desktop workspace uses the same native engine session across Document, Source and the read-only Split preview. Source edits reach the same session without rasterizing hidden pages. Browser tests verify that the old paginator and MathLive do not load. Full coverage and physical device checks are required before making this the default.

nativeHost.scope: Windows x64, macOS arm64 and Ubuntu x64 passed their Rust native host tests and the three real LuaLaTeX session, project and text-observation tests. Browser cross-reference navigation and desktop WebView acceptance are separate gates.

legacyDisabled.scope: Two-platform Chromium with legacy pagination and MathLive disabled. Mixed prose and display formula edit, undo/redo, root insertion, exact source bytes, plain bold prose, table cells, headings, and synthetic IME. Real LuaLaTeX geometry is replayed in a separate browser gate with a simulated transport.

desktopWebView.scope: GitHub-hosted WebView2 and WKWebView start with legacy pagination and MathLive disabled. The embedded font, PDF worker, and native IPC are checked. Physical key delivery, candidate placement and display scan-out remain separate acceptance items.
